Challenges

Sound familiar?

“Ask ChatGPT about our category and we don’t exist.”

Models recommend brands with consistent, well-sourced web presence. The perception audit grades what each assistant says — and the gap analysis finds which sources drive it.

“The models describe our pricing from 2022.”

Stale facts persist where old sources dominate. Source-led fixes publish correct, citable facts where models actually read.

“An assistant invented features we don’t have.”

Hallucinations grow in information vacuums. Definitive source content — docs, guides, comparisons — gives models something accurate to repeat.

“Reviews say one thing, our site says another.”

Inconsistency becomes vagueness in model answers. The entity alignment checklist reconciles facts across site, reviews, press and forums.

“Competitors get recommended with half our product.”

Recommendation share follows source share. Citation source builds put your evidence where models gather theirs.

“We can’t measure any of this.”

You can: a prompt panel of real buyer questions, run monthly and scored for accuracy, sentiment and citation share.

“Our category is being defined by Reddit threads.”

Forums are model sources whether you participate or not. The roadmap includes the community sources your buyers’ questions draw on.

“Legal is nervous about what AI says about us.”

Perception reports give legal and leadership a factual record of model statements — and a fix path for the wrong ones.

How It Works

Your brand, as the models understand it

LLMs answer from patterns across training data and live retrieval: your site, reviews, press, forums and documentation. Inconsistent or thin information becomes vague or wrong answers about your business.

LLM SEO aligns that information ecosystem — authoritative source content, consistent entity data, expert material worth quoting — and verifies the effect by testing real prompts across the major assistants.

  • LLM perception audit
  • Prompt panel & scoring
  • Source-content roadmap
  • Entity alignment checklist
  • Citation source builds
  • Monthly perception reports

FAQs

FAQs on LLM SEO services

How is LLM SEO different from AI SEO?

AI SEO covers AI search surfaces generally; LLM SEO focuses on how the models themselves understand and describe your brand, tested via prompts.

Can you control what ChatGPT says about us?

No one controls it directly — but the sources it draws from can be built and aligned, which measurably changes answers.

Which assistants do you test?

ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Copilot as standard; others on request.

How do you report progress?

A fixed prompt panel scored monthly — accuracy, sentiment, recommendation share — so movement is visible, not vibes.

Can you change what a model was trained on?

No — and anyone promising that is misleading you. What can change is what models retrieve live, what the sources they trust say, and how consistent your facts are. That is where this program works.

How fast does perception change?

Retrieval-driven answers can shift in weeks as sources update; deeper shifts build over months of source work. The monthly panel shows the movement either way.
